settings.echoCancellationDescription: Removes the other person’s voice from the microphone when it comes back through the speakers, so their words are not transcribed twice. Applies while both the microphone and system audio are recording.
settings.echoTextFilterDescription: If a microphone phrase repeats what just came out of the speakers word for word, it is left out of the transcript. Only needed when echo cancellation is unavailable: it cannot tell an echo from a deliberate repetition, so it is off by default.
settings.singleRemoteSpeakerDescription: The microphone is you and the speakers are the other person. Voices are not clustered: the two capture channels already know who is who, and clustering tends to split one person into several “Speakers”. Turn this off for calls with several remote participants.

about.productSummary: A free, open fork of Meetily that unlocks every feature for everyone. It captures, transcribes and summarizes your meetings entirely on your own machine — with GPU acceleration, bring-your-own-key cloud models, and local-first data ownership.
about.highlightPrivateDetail: No telemetry, nothing leaves your PC
about.forkCredit: Meetily - Actually Free fork by Tyler Buza
about.tagline: Real-time notes and summaries that never leave your machine.
about.latestVersion: You are running the latest version
about.featurePrivacyDetail: Your data & AI processing workflow can now stay within your premise. No cloud, no leaks.
about.featureAnyModelDetail: Prefer local open-source model? Great. Want to plug in an external API? Also fine. No lock-in.
about.featureCostDetail: Avoid pay-per-minute bills by running models locally (or pay only for the calls you choose).
about.featureEverywhereDetail: Google Meet, Zoom, Teams-online or offline.

app.postCallSpeakersRefreshed: Speaker labels refreshed from the saved transcript.
app.postCallEnhancedAndRefreshed: Transcript enhanced and speaker labels refreshed.
app.postCallNoFolder: The recording folder is unavailable for enhancement.
app.postCallSpeakerCountError: Enter the total number of speakers, from 1 to 20.
app.postCallUsingLiveDescription: No enhanced audio pass was applied; the saved live text remains available.
app.postCallHowManyDescription: Include yourself in the total. Entering the actual number gives more accurate speaker labels, or choose Auto-detect if you are not sure.
app.postCallKeepReviewing: You can keep reviewing the live transcript while this finishes.
app.localStackReadFailed: Could not read local stack status

security.lockSubtitle: Enter your password to open the recordings and transcripts.
security.noRecoveryHint: No recovery code was kept for this archive: the password is the only way in.
security.recoveryUnlockSubtitle: Enter the code from your printout and set a new password.
security.recoveryShownOnceBody: This is the only moment the code exists in readable form. Write it down or print it and keep it away from this computer. It cannot be shown again — only replaced.
security.recoveryAcknowledge: I have written the code down and stored it safely.
security.recoveryPrintExplanation: This code opens the archive if the password is forgotten. Keep this sheet away from the computer. Anyone holding this code can open the recordings.
security.settingsDescription: A password locks the archive of recordings and transcripts. The encryption key is stored wrapped in the password, so changing the password does not rewrite the archive.
security.scopeNotice: At this stage the password gates access through the app. Encrypting the recording files and the database comes in the next stages — until then the files on disk read as they did before.
security.protectionOn: The archive is protected by a password
security.wantRecoveryCodeHint: A second way into the archive if the password is forgotten. Shown once.
security.noRecoveryCodeWarning: Without a recovery code, a forgotten password means losing every recording. There would be nothing to restore them with.
security.disableProtectionHint: To remove protection or issue a new code, enter your current password in the field above.
security.autoLockHint: The key is wiped from memory and the archive asks for the password again. Never happens during a recording.
security.changePasswordKeepsRecovery: The recovery code keeps working after the password changes.
security.recoveryCodeExists: A recovery code has been issued. A new one replaces it: the old one stops opening the archive.
security.recoveryCodeMissing: There is no recovery code. A forgotten password would lose the archive.
security.errorWrongRecoveryCode: This code does not open the archive.
security.errorRecoveryTypo: There is a typo in the code — check what you entered.
security.errorRecoveryWrongLength: The code has 32 characters. Check that you entered all of it.
security.errorRecoveryBadCharacter: The code contains a character it cannot contain.
security.errorPasswordTooShort: The password must be at least {minimum} characters.
security.errorNoRecoveryCode: No recovery code was issued for this archive.
security.errorRecordingInProgress: The archive cannot be locked while recording.
security.errorAlreadyConfigured: The archive is already protected by a password.
security.errorKeystoreCorrupt: The key file is damaged. Do not set a new password — restore the file from a backup first.
security.errorUnknown: That did not work. Details are in the application log.
